description: Whether a company runs ads now on the public Google ad library (the Ads Transparency Center), by its domain. Returns a one-line `summary`, a `platforms` entry with its `status` (ok, no_ads, not_resolved, not_covered, unreadable with a `reason`), the advertiser and how it was resolved, and the live ads (text, media, first and last seen, countries, landing URL, status, format). Only `no_ads` means the company runs no ads there; `not_resolved` means the advertiser was not found, so pass google_advertiser_id and ask again. A field the library does not show is null. Costs $0.006 per lookup whose status is ok, on the first page; everything else is free. Page with `cursor`. Coverage: worldwide, verified advertisers' ads shown in the last 30 days. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

google_advertiser_id.description: Pin the Google advertiser (AR followed by digits).

platform.description: google (the library on sale today). Omit for every library on sale.
